fixed_selection: Exhaust the three fixed resident actions on all training seeds; select once per declared environment before holdout. All losing candidate work is retained. Every final arm shares this choice and the same trained latency forecast.
forecast: Only training dimensions are measured. Each component is normalized by n squared, interpolated between training dimensions and rescaled to the held-out dimension. Retirement uses the training median independent of n. Final outcomes never update the forecast. The next state uses its own observed actual cost and current request/signal only.
paired_order: Rotate and reverse all eight arms by environment, seed, dimension and repeat; preserve every scheduled cell, including refusal, timeout and abstention. No best-of reruns.
external_objective: The scenario's frozen state-price, discount and conditional downside rule. All arms share this external evaluator. Fixed-preference NDU only changes its internal planning preferences; ordinary MPC uses the same horizon and additive-cost planning. Same-objective control and independent exact oracle use the full same risk-recursive objective.
native_measurement: Reuse the unchanged source-bound native matrix workload: two generated affine u32 matrices, one physical packed-cache slot, allocation/transpose/retirement and checked matrix-vector execution. This is real CPU execution on controlled generated inputs, not a production workload or HIA compiler performance result.
cost_boundary: Episode wall includes source-bound worker startup, initialization and initially resident cache preparation, observation, controller, original NDU transport/verification/logging, workload allocation/load/retirement/kernel/output oracle, and both worker cleanups. Nested kernel/service/controller times are diagnostics and must not be summed with episode wall. Offline calibration, all fixed-policy candidates, native construction, scientific audit and whole campaign wall are retained separately. Historical development, human review, energy and money are unknown, not zero.
causal_boundary: The planner takes immutable Observation and Scenario only; no episode seed, hidden regime, future realized request, future latency or oracle answer. Python object separation is not an adversarial memory sandbox.
model_diagnostics: After the frozen primary cohort, retain all three environments and holdout seeds for correct-model, inverted-posterior and reset-prior controls. These are explicit error interventions, not learned predictors or claims about unknown distribution shifts. They cannot tune or replace primary outcomes.

acceptance.wiring: Both non-dominated hand-calculated action reversals must pass original native evaluation and the independent exact solver; digest-only changes leave numeric values unchanged.
acceptance.causal_execution: Every selected real cache action matches executed state, every output is checked, all physical allocations are retired, every failed or missing request remains in the planned denominator.
acceptance.same_objective: Native dynamic values/actions agree with separately encoded exact finite-model values/actions. A tie is a correctness pass and provides no evidence of NDU-exclusive gain.
acceptance.net_gain: For each environment, dynamic NDU must deliver all scheduled requests and beat every non-oracle registered controller on paired end-to-end wall after measured offline allocations. Report exploratory paired confidence intervals and every scenario; no aggregate may hide a failed environment.
acceptance.production: No production activation, merge qualification, general FBSDE solution or learned-parameter gradient is established by this study. Unsupported gates remain open.
